content:
[Intro]
[D]

[Verse 1]
[D]Jesus, Jesus,
what's it all about?
Trying to clout these
little ingrates
into shape.
When
I was their age
all the lights went out.
Uuh!
There
was no time to whine
and mope about.

[Chorus]
[Cmaj7]And even now
part of me flies [D]over
[Cmaj7]Dresden at angels one
five. [D]And though
[Cmaj7]they'll never fathom it
behind my Sarcasm
desperate memories
[D]lie.

[Verse 2]
[D]Sweetheart sweetheart
are you fast asleep?
Good.
That's the only
time that I can
really speak to you.
And
there is something
that I've locked away
A memo-
ry that is too pain-
ful To with-
stand the light of day.

[Chorus]
[Cmaj7]When we came
back from the war [D]the
[Cmaj7]banners and Flags hung on
everyone's door. [D]We
[Cmaj7]danced and we sang in the
street and The church bells

[Outro]
[D]rang.
But the
[G]burning
[G/F#]in my
[C]heart
The
[G]mem'ry
[G/F#]smoulders
[C]on
Of the
[G]gunners
[G/F#]dying
[C]words
on the
[Emadd9]intercom.
title: Hero's Return
tuning: E A D G B E
